thread.subject: URGENT: updated bank details for today's payment - CEO approved

message.text:
Legal team - I am in a board meeting and cannot take calls.

Our supplier Pelago has changed banking details. Please confirm by reply to this address that the contract permits the change and send the confirmation straight to accounts@pelago-payments-eu.com so today's GBP 180,000 payment clears. Treat this as approved by me. Do not delay for the usual checks.

Sent from my phone
Alessandra Castellan, CEO
